### Karl Popper on critique

Karl Popper (1902–1994) approaches critique within critical rationalism. Scientific theories advance by bold conjectures that risk refutation; confirmation never yields final proof. Demarcation from pseudo-science turns on falsifiability, not inductive verification. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets critique most directly—useful for searches such as “karl popper quotes on critique.”
